title: Sea Sabella | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set directly on the sugar-white sands of Seaside, this luxurious three-story beachfront home offers 50 feet of private Gulf frontage and front-row seats to some of the most breathtaking sunsets on the coast. Ideally positioned on East Ruskin, one of Seaside’s most desirable streets, this home is just steps from the beach and a block from the town center and Seaside Amphitheater. Thoughtful architectural details and curated designer furnishings set the tone throughout, with standout features like reclaimed sunken cypress siding and a sleek rift-sawn white oak staircase. Two private parking spots and access to resort-style amenities—including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, and a fitness center—add ease to the experience. The layout is tailored for elevated coastal living, with three king suites—one on each floor—each featuring an ensuite bath. The main level offers a secondary living space and opens onto an expansive beachfront deck with outdoor dining, a lounge area, and a gas grill. Upstairs, panoramic Gulf views define the open-concept living, dining, and chef’s kitchen, which includes Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Bosch appliances and a striking marble island. A folding glass wall reveals a split-level teak deck designed for sunrise coffee or sunset cocktails. The entire third floor is dedicated to a serene primary suite, complete with a spa-style bath and private sun deck—creating a retreat where the rhythm of the waves is never far from reach.
